rule: a template printed with single braces
why: A TEMPLATE PRINTED AND NOT FILLED, `{name}`: this gate's own `open-braces` rule, which the lint's double-brace rule does not see. The rest of the screen is the decoy every printed tree carries: a date in words, an amount, a run's handle beside its name and a person's name, none of which is a finding, so a rule that grew too wide takes the count above one.
